problem: A user voice onset can correctly interrupt an in-progress text/voice reply while the interrupted turn's deferred wrap-up still runs too early. That can perform final swap or queued agent callbacks while the user is still speaking, or let an older voice turn settle work owned by a newer turn. Pinned N.E.K.O already has an end-to-end independent-ASR regression file for this ownership.

reuse_order.result: c3 test_voice_turn_wrap_up_hold.py exercises the real core prepare/dispatch/cancel paths, independent-ASR voice registry and offline reply ownership.
Latest upstream remains c3; no newer implementation is required.
Keep native interruption, voice-turn registry, owed-wrap-up and session authority. No XiaoYu interruption state machine.
No external component owns N.E.K.O core turn wrap-up ownership.
Generic cancellation libraries cannot replace host turn/session ownership and would not preserve native final-swap/agent-callback semantics.
Only wire selected existing N.E.K.O tests into the patched product gate/local release and repeat two race-critical cases in micro-soak.
Reject new interruption router, conversation state machine, callback ledger or TTS/ASR runtime.

protected_product_risks: old typed reply finishes wrap-up while user is still speaking
interruption awaits transport before establishing the hold, leaving a race window
older voice turn clears or pays work owned by a newer voice turn
voice onset cutting an earlier voice reply loses or prematurely runs final swap / queued agent callbacks
retirement_condition: Retire this overlay wiring when pinned N.E.K.O upstream CI runs equivalent voice-onset interruption/wrap-up ownership regressions for every pin XiaoYu consumes and XiaoYu can consume that result without duplicating test selection.
